title: Exhaustive Adam2Jesus Biblical Expansion (Judges, House of Saul, All 20 Kings of Judah, All 19 Kings of Israel, High Priests, Prophets, Esther, Job, Dual Line to Jesus, Herodians & Foreign Kings)

nodes.name: Seir the Horite (Pre-Edomite Patriarch of Mount Seir, Gen 36:20)
nodes.notes: Original Horite patriarch of Mount Seir whose 7 sons (Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, Dishan) and daughters (Timna, Oholibamah) merged with Esau's house.

nodes.name: Melchizedek (King & Priest of Salem)
nodes.role: King of Righteousness & Priest of El Elyon
nodes.notes: King of Salem (Jerusalem) who blesses Abraham. Book of Jasher 16:11 & Targums identify him with Shem son of Noah; his name ('King of Righteousness') also echoes Phoenician Sydyk in Sanchuniathon!

nodes.name: Patriarch Job (of the Land of Uz, Job 1:1)
nodes.role: Righteous Patriarch of Uz & Father of Jemimah, Keziah & Keren-happuch
nodes.notes: Dwelt in the Land of Uz; debated by Eliphaz the Temanite (Esau!), Bildad the Shuhite (Shuah/Abraham!), Zophar the Naamathite, and Elihu the Buzite.

nodes.name: Joshua / Hoshea ben Nun (Ephraimite Leader of Conquest)
nodes.role: Successor of Moses & Conqueror of Canaan
nodes.notes: Joshua (Tribe of Ephraim via Beriah -> Elishama -> Nun) succeeded Moses to lead Israel across the Jordan.

nodes.name: Zelophehad ben Hepher (Manasseh — Father of 5 Pioneering Daughters, Num 27)
nodes.role: Father of Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah & Tirzah
nodes.notes: Manasseh -> Machir -> Gilead -> Hepher -> Zelophehad, whose 5 daughters established landmark female inheritance rights in Israel!

nodes.name: Korah ben Izhar (Patriarch of the Korahite Levites, Exod 6:21; 1 Chr 6)
nodes.role: Levitical Patriarch of Samuel & Korahite Psalmists
nodes.notes: Izhar -> Korah -> Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph (direct ancestors of Prophet Samuel, Heman, and the Korahite psalmists!).

nodes.name: Goliath of Gath (Philistine Giant Descended From Anakim, 1 Sam 17)
nodes.notes: Champion of Gath descended from the Anakim remnant spared at Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod; slain by young David.

nodes.name: Balaam ben Beor (of Pethor, Aram — Num 22–24; Deir Alla)
nodes.role: Aramean Seer Attested in the Deir Alla Inscription!
nodes.notes: Summoned by Moabite King Balak (son of Zippor) to curse Israel; archaeologically attested in the 8th-c. BCE Deir Alla plaster inscription in Jordan!

nodes.name: 1. Judge Othniel (son of Kenaz + Achsah)
nodes.notes: First Judge of Israel; nephew/brother of Caleb who marries Caleb's daughter Achsah.

nodes.name: 2. Judge Ehud (son of Gera, Benjamin)
nodes.notes: Left-handed Benjaminite deliverer who slew Moabite King Eglon.

nodes.name: 3. Judge Shamgar (son of Anath)
nodes.notes: Delivered Israel from 600 Philistines with an oxgoad.

nodes.name: 4. Prophetess & Judge Deborah (+ Lappidoth)
nodes.notes: Prophetess & Judge of Israel who led General Barak against Canaanite commander Sisera.

nodes.name: 5. Judge Gideon / Jerubbaal (son of Joash, Manasseh)
nodes.notes: Abiezrite of Manasseh who defeated Midian with 300 men; father of Abimelech, Jotham, and 70 sons.

nodes.name: 6. Judge Tola ben Puah (Issachar, Judg 10:1)
nodes.notes: Son of Puah, son of Dodo, a man of Issachar who judged Israel 23 years at Shamir.

nodes.name: 8. Judge Jephthah (of Gilead)
nodes.notes: Mighty warrior of Gilead who delivered Israel from the Ammonites; father of Seila.

nodes.name: 9. Judge Ibzan of Bethlehem (Judg 12:8–10)
nodes.notes: Judged Israel 7 years; had 30 sons and 30 daughters.

nodes.name: 12. Judge Samson (son of Manoah of Zorah, Dan)
nodes.notes: Nazirite strongman of the Tribe of Dan (+ Delilah) who battled the Philistines.

nodes.name: Judge & High Priest Eli of Shiloh (Ithamar's Line, 1 Sam 1–4)
nodes.notes: Descended from Aaron's son Ithamar; priest at Shiloh who mentored young Samuel; father of Hophni & Phinehas.

nodes.name: Prophet & Judge Samuel (son of Elkanah & Hannah)
nodes.notes: Kohathite Levite (via Korah -> Elkanah & Hannah); final Judge who anointed BOTH King Saul and King David!

nodes.name: King Saul ben Kish (1st King of Israel, c. 1050–1010 BCE)
nodes.notes: Anointed by Samuel; father of Jonathan, Abinadab, Malchi-shua, Ish-bosheth, Armoni, Mephibosheth II, Merab, and Michal.

nodes.name: Crown Prince Jonathan ben Saul (1 Sam 14, 18–20)
nodes.role: Heir of King Saul & Covenant Friend of David
nodes.notes: Covenant friend of David; fell with Saul on Mt. Gilboa; father of Mephibosheth.

nodes.name: Eliab (Eldest Brother of King David, 1 Sam 16:6; 1 Chr 2:13)
nodes.role: Firstborn Son of Jesse & Brother of King David
nodes.notes: Eldest brother of King David; father of Abihail (ancestor of Queen Mahalath) and grandfather of Zeruiah/Abigail kin.

nodes.name: Eliam / Ammiel ben Ahithophel (Father of Bathsheba, 2 Sam 11:3, 23:34)
nodes.role: One of David's Mighty Thirty & Father of Queen Bathsheba
nodes.notes: Son of counselor Ahithophel of Giloh and father of Bathsheba (mother of Nathan & Solomon).

nodes.name: Hadad the Edomite (+ Sister of Queen Tahpenes of Egypt, 1 Kgs 11:14–22)
nodes.role: Edomite Prince Raised in Pharaoh's Palace
nodes.notes: Fled Edom to Egypt, married the sister of Egyptian Queen Tahpenes, and fathered Genubath.

nodes.name: Rehoboam (1st King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Son of Solomon & Naamah the Ammonitess; invaded by Pharaoh Shishak (Shoshenq I).

nodes.name: Abijah / Abijam (2nd King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Son of Rehoboam & Queen Maacah.

nodes.name: Asa (3rd King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Reforming king who defeated Zerah the Cushite.

nodes.name: Jehoshaphat (4th King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Son of Asa & Azubah; allied with Ahab of Israel.

nodes.name: Jehoram (5th King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Married Athaliah (daughter of Ahab & Jezebel), uniting the royal houses of Judah, Israel, and Sidon.

nodes.name: Ahaziah (6th King of Judah, 841 BCE)
nodes.notes: Son of Jehoram & Queen Athaliah; slain by Jehu; father of King Joash.

nodes.name: Joash / Jehoash (7th King of Judah, 835–796 BCE)
nodes.notes: Hidden in the Temple by Aunt Jehosheba & High Priest Jehoiada; father of King Amaziah.

nodes.name: Uzziah / Azariah (10th King of Judah, 792–740 BCE)
nodes.notes: 52-year reign attested in Aramaic Uzziah tablet; father of King Jotham.

nodes.name: King Hezekiah (13th King of Judah, 715–686 BCE)
nodes.notes: Withstood Sennacherib's siege alongside Isaiah & Cushite Pharaoh Taharqa; ancestor of Prophet Zephaniah.

nodes.name: Manasseh (14th King of Judah, 697–643 BCE)
nodes.notes: Longest-reigning king of Judah; vassal of Esarhaddon & Ashurbanipal.

nodes.name: King Josiah (16th King of Judah, 640–609 BCE)
nodes.notes: Great Deuteronomic reformer; fell at Megiddo confronting Pharaoh Neco II (609 BCE).

nodes.name: Jehoiakim / Eliakim (18th King of Judah, 609–598 BCE)
nodes.notes: Second son of Josiah; father of exiled King Jehoiachin.

nodes.name: Jehoiachin / Jeconiah (19th King of Judah, 598–597 BCE)
nodes.notes: Son of Jehoiakim carried to Babylon (attested in Nebuchadnezzar's ration tablets!); father of 7 exilic sons including Shealtiel & Pedaiah.

nodes.name: 1. Jeroboam I ben Nebat (1st King of Israel, 931–909 BCE)
nodes.notes: First King of the Northern Kingdom of Israel (10 tribes); sheltered earlier by Pharaoh Shishak in Egypt.

nodes.name: 3. Baasha ben Ahijah (3rd King of Israel, 909–886 BCE)
nodes.notes: Founder of the second northern dynasty (Tribe of Issachar); father of Elah.

nodes.name: 6. King Omri (Founder of House of Omri & Samaria, 885–874 BCE)
nodes.notes: Founder of Samaria ('Bit-Humria' in Assyrian records & Mesha Stele); father of King Ahab.

nodes.name: 10. King Jehu ben Jehoshaphat (841–814 BCE; Black Obelisk)
nodes.notes: Anointed by Elisha's prophet; bowed on Shalmaneser III's Black Obelisk ('Yaua son of Omri'); founded 5-king Jehu dynasty.

nodes.name: 19. King Hoshea ben Elah (Final King of Israel, 732–722 BCE)
nodes.notes: Final king of Northern Israel before Samaria fell to Shalmaneser V / Sargon II (722 BCE — Assyrian Exile!).

nodes.name: High Priest Zadok I (David & Solomon's High Priest, 1 Chr 6:8)
nodes.role: Founder of the Zadokite High Priesthood
nodes.notes: Son of Ahitub I (via Aaron -> Eleazar -> Phinehas -> Abishua -> Bukki -> Uzzi -> Zerahiah -> Meraioth -> Amariah); anointed Solomon.

nodes.name: Ezra the Priest & Scribe (ben Seraiah, Ezra 7:1–5)
nodes.role: Zadokite Priest-Scribe Dispatched by Artaxerxes I
nodes.notes: Direct son/descendant of First Temple High Priest Seraiah (Ezra 7:1); commissioned by Artaxerxes I to restore Torah law in Jerusalem.

nodes.name: John the Baptist (Son of Zechariah & Elizabeth, Luke 1)
nodes.role: Aaronic Forerunner Prophet & Kinsman of Jesus
nodes.notes: Son of Priest Zechariah (course of Abijah) and Elizabeth (kinswoman of Virgin Mary); baptized Jesus at the Jordan.

nodes.name: Prophet Elijah the Tishbite (of Gilead, 1 Kgs 17 – 2 Kgs 2)
nodes.role: Prophet Opposing House of Ahab & Baal
nodes.notes: Confronted Ahab & Jezebel on Mt. Carmel and ascended in a whirlwind before Elisha.

nodes.name: Prophet Isaiah ben Amoz (Royal Court Prophet, Isa 1, 7–8)
nodes.notes: Prophesied under Kings Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah; father of Shear-jashub & Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

nodes.name: Prophet Jeremiah ben Hilkiah of Anathoth (Jer 1–52)
nodes.role: Priestly Prophet of the Fall of Jerusalem
nodes.notes: Priestly prophet at Anathoth who witnessed 586 BCE fall of Jerusalem alongside scribe Baruch.

nodes.name: Prophet Daniel / Belteshazzar (Babylon & Susa, Dan 1–12)
nodes.role: Judean Royal Statesman & Prophet Under Nebuchadnezzar & Cyrus
nodes.notes: Exiled royal Judean youth who interpreted Nebuchadnezzar's and Belshazzar's visions and served into Cyrus's reign.

nodes.name: Prophet Hosea ben Beeri (+ Gomer, Hos 1:1)
nodes.role: First of the Twelve Minor Prophets
nodes.notes: Prophesied during Jeroboam II's reign; married Gomer bat Diblaim.

nodes.name: Mordecai ben Jair (Tribe of Benjamin, Susa; Esth 2:5)
nodes.era: 5th c. BCE (Susa / Persia — Book of Esther)
nodes.role: Benjaminite Statesman & Guardian of Queen Esther
nodes.notes: Descendant of Benjamite Kish/Shimei; cousin and adoptive guardian of Queen Esther opposite Haman the Agagite.

nodes.name: Joseph of Nazareth (Husband of Mary; Son of Jacob, Matt 1:16)
nodes.role: Legal Father of Jesus in Matthew 1 Royal Line
nodes.notes: Son of Jacob ben Matthan (Matthew 1:15-16); husband of the Virgin Mary and legal father of Jesus of Nazareth.

nodes.name: Blessed Virgin Mary (Daughter of Heli/Joachim & Anne; Luke 1–3)
nodes.role: Mother of Jesus of Nazareth (Luke 3 Davidic Line)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Joachim/Heli & Saint Anne, betrothed to Joseph of Nazareth, mother of Jesus Christ and kinswoman of Elizabeth.

nodes.name: Jesus of Nazareth ('The Christ', Matt 1; Luke 3)
nodes.role: Culmination of Both Matthew 1 & Luke 3 Genealogies
nodes.notes: Born in Bethlehem of Mary (Luke 3 line) & legal son of Joseph (Matthew 1 line) during Caesar Augustus & Herod the Great; siblings include James the Just and Jude.

nodes.name: Apostle Paul (Saul of Tarsus — Tribe of Benjamin)
nodes.role: Benjaminite Pharisee & Apostle to the Mediterranean
nodes.notes: Born in Tarsus (Cilicia — cf. Cilix/Tarshish!) of the Tribe of Benjamin; carried the Judeo-Christian movement across Anatolia, Greece (Athens/Corinth), and Rome!

nodes.name: Herodian Royal Client Dynasty Hub (Idumea → Judea → Armenia & Rome)
nodes.notes: Structural anchor uniting the Herodian rulers across Judea, Chalcis, Armenia (Tigranes V/VI), Cilicia, Emesa, and the Roman Senate.

nodes.name: Merodach-baladan → Nebuchadnezzar II → Evil-merodach (Neo-Babylon)
nodes.role: Conqueror of Jerusalem & Builder of Babylon's Ishtar Gate
nodes.notes: Nebuchadnezzar II besieged Jerusalem (597 & 586 BCE), exiled Jehoiachin and Daniel, and built the Hanging Gardens/Ishtar Gate; succeeded by Evil-merodach (Amel-Marduk) who released King Jehoiachin!

nodes.name: Tiglath-Pileser III (Pul) → Sennacherib → Esarhaddon → Ashurbanipal
nodes.role: Assyrian Emperors of the Biblical Books of Kings & Isaiah
nodes.notes: Tiglath-Pileser III (Pul) exacted tribute from Israel/Judah; Sennacherib besieged Hezekiah (Taylor Prism) before being slain by sons Adrammelech & Sharezer; Esarhaddon & Ashurbanipal (Osnappar) conquered Egypt (Taharqa)!

nodes.name: King Hiram of Tyre, King Mesha of Moab (Mesha Stele) & Hazael of Aram
nodes.role: Levantine Monarchs Attested in Bible & Inscriptions
nodes.notes: Hiram of Tyre supplied cedar & craftsman Huram-Abi for Solomon's Temple; King Mesha of Moab's 840 BCE Stele mentions Omri, Israel & 'House of David'; King Hazael of Damascus (Tel Dan Stele) fought Jehoram & Ahaziah!

nodes.name: Pharaoh Neco II (26th Saite Dynasty of Egypt)
nodes.role: Pharaoh at Battle of Megiddo (609 BCE) & Carchemish (605 BCE)
nodes.notes: Marched north to aid Assyria against Babylon, slaying King Josiah at Megiddo (609 BCE) and installing Jehoiakim; Herodotus credits Neco II with commissioning Phoenician sailors to circumnavigate Africa!
